comments.message: The new MCP mount is missing the existing `async with mcp_app.lifespan(app)` wrapper around the FastAPI lifespan. FastMCP uses that lifespan to initialize session management, so rebasing this branch as-is will regress `/mcp` for stateful MCP clients even though the sub-app is mounted.

This reintroduces the slashless `/mcp` bug. The app still runs with `redirect_slashes=False`, but this branch drops the explicit `/mcp` -> `/mcp/` 307 handler while README and Settings now advertise `http://localhost:8000/mcp`. Clients configured from those examples will 404 unless the redirect route from `main` is preserved.
